items: Once a franchise network grows beyond a handful of locations, spreadsheets and phone calls can't keep operators aligned, and dedicated franchise management software becomes necessary.
Judge platforms on franchise-specific functionality, ease of adoption for both franchisor and franchisee, fair pricing, scalability and the quality of vendor support.
Match the tool to your main challenge: accounting and back office, food cost and inventory, POS and menu changes, or audits and consistent execution on every shift.
For guest experience across the network, Momos brings every location's reviews into one Unified Inbox, replies with its AI agent Alfie, and shows where incidents happen most.
